preconditions.description: The number of planks n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= h <= 10**9 for h in h_list)
preconditions.description: Each plank height h_i is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (l_i, r_i) satisfies 1 ≤ l_i ≤ r_i ≤ n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query.
Each output line is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= n for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= n - (r - l + 1) for i, (l, r) in enumerate(queries) if (r - l + 1) <= n)
postconditions.description: For each query (l, r), the output is the count of distinct matching pieces, where a matching piece must not intersect with the query piece and must have the same width.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= n for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: The output for each query is the number of distinct matching pieces, where a matching piece (l2, r2) satisfies: (1) non-intersecting with (l, r), (2) same width (r - l + 1), and (3) for all i in 0..(r-l), h[l + i] + h[l2 + i] == h[l] + h[l2].
